name: prompt-coach
description: Holds back a typed prompt that looks ambiguous (no done-condition, unclear target) and offers to send it as is or add one; off by default

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Judge each typed prompt before it is sent; off by default

model.title: Judge model
model.description: Model alias or id that judges the prompt

timeoutMs.title: Time limit (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long the judgment may take, 500 to 3000; past it the prompt is sent unchanged
